messages:
Alex M.: deploy-bot queued v4.0.0 rollout for API/runtime/console/router at 03:00 UTC. change window 90m. tagging infra and owners.
deploy-bot: Scheduled rollout v4.0.0 -> targets: api:4.0.0, runtime:2.7.0, console:5.1.0, router:1.9.0. Waves: canary 1% -> 5% -> 25% -> 100%. Start: 7090000000.
Priya S.: quick heads up from preflight: API v4 tightened auth header validation — requires `x-client-id` or reject 401. Console 5.1 currently doesn't send that header by default.
Naomi G.: ah, we saw this in staging but forgot to flip the compatibility shim on. console 5.1 has opt-in header, not opt-out. Test harness didn't fail because the mock API accepted missing header.
Dan (oncall): options: (A) enable console shim to add `x-client-id` (hotfix), (B) toggle router rewrite that strips headers, (C) pin API at 3.9 for the wave. Pin is lowest risk for this window.
Alex M.: hotfix could be risky and may not make the window. Router toggle requires owner ack. Pin API to 3.9 seems safest. We can ship API v4 next week with a compatibility flag.
api-owner: if pin required, need approval since it delays API rollout for teams. But OK for this emergency window. +1 pending release lead.
deploy-bot: Pending change: api -> pinned to 3.9 for wave. Waiting approvals from api-owner and release lead. Approvals: api-owner (+1).
Priya S.: also note runtime 2.7.0 includes a KV schema bump that's backward compatible for reads, but writes need schema flag. We're keeping runtime anyway. No change needed.
Naomi G.: can we do console shim in parallel post-deploy? create a small compatibility PR to flip header on by default for the next minor.
Alex M.: agreed. Action: create PR for console shim and a rollout plan for API v4 with feature flag gating. Assign tasks after this thread.
release-bot: Release lead (@Alex M.) approved at 7090000015. deploy-bot: proceeding with canary with api pinned to 3.9.
deploy-bot: Starting canary: api pinned 3.9 -> 1%, runtime 2.7.0 -> 1%, console 5.1.0 -> 1%, router 1.9.0 -> 1%. Logs: ```[canary] api: pinned at 3.9
[canary] console: ok (no x-client-id)
[canary] runtime: ok
[canary] router: ok
```
Dan (oncall): monitoring: auth failures initial spike 0.9% (some older clients), not related to console. Keep an eye for 401s.
Priya S.: telemetry shows console requests are fine. no 4xx increase from console paths.
Alex M.: hold at 1% for 12m, require stable error <1.5% to go to 5%.
release-bot: metric gate passed. progressing to 5%.
deploy-bot: progressing to 5% -> 25% per plan. Logs: ```[5%] api: stable
[25%] api: stable
```
Naomi G.: small note: we'll still include a public release note: "API v4 scheduled but temporarily deferred due to header compatibility; API pinned at 3.9 for this release window." Jessy in comms to review.
Alex M.: create follow-ups: (1) console header shim PR (owner: Naomi G.), (2) router header rewrite audit (owner: router-team), (3) API v4 gated rollout plan + integration tests (owner: api-owner), (4) add cross-service test to CI that uses real router behavior (owner: Priya S.).
Dan (oncall): rollback playbook: if auth 401s >2% on user-facing endpoints -> rollback api to 3.8 and abort. deploy-bot will assist with automated rollback triggers.
release-bot: Release completed to 100% with api pinned. Summary: canary -> full. No major customer impact. Recommend postmortem item for test harness mismatch.
Alex M.: thanks everyone. I'll draft short retro note and assign tickets. Good catch by Priya and Naomi. :thumbsup:
Priya S.: noted. will add CI test ticket now.
Naomi G.: will open console shim PR and link here.
deploy-bot: thread closed by release-bot at 7090000030.
